name: AI Resource Router
purpose: Choose the best AI/tool for a task using capability fit, available quota, reset urgency, cost/opportunity, context needs and execution mode; output a dispatch plan and prompt.
triggers: more than one AI subscription/tool/account is available and it is unclear which should take which task
a quota reset, extra-reset expiry, or renewal boundary is approaching
a batch of tasks needs to be assigned across tools before work starts
a daily/weekly AI deployment plan is needed
non_triggers: abstract tool benchmarking with no actual task to route
producing quota/cost/reset data that was not supplied
doing the routed domain work itself instead of producing a dispatch prompt
deep implementation planning, exhaustive research, or multi-skill workflow sequencing
quality_gates: routes but does not execute unrelated domain work
weekly/monthly capacity prioritized over irrelevant short windows when appropriate
every dispatch prompt is task-specific, not generic
stop_conditions: all tasks routed or explicitly listed unroutable, all four artifacts produced -> COMPLETE
no capacity data exists for any available tool -> BLOCKED, state what snapshot is needed
some tasks routed, others blocked on missing data -> PARTIAL, list which and why
never continue past the dispatch plan into performing the routed work itself
